profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Synthego
profile.summary:
I'm a passionate software engineer with nearly 10 years of professional experience, but have been programming since I figured out TI-BASIC on my TI-84 calculator in high school! I gravitate towards the most technical and difficult challenges, and have a reputation for taking on daunting tasks. I am proficient in Java, Python, C, C++, and the suite of web languages. I am a quick learner with a strong software engineering foundation that allows me to pick up new concepts easily. 

In my first post-graduate role at Lockheed Martin, I taught myself Synthetic Aperture Radar specifics in order to create a custom Quality Assessment image analysis tool. This resulted in a customizable image analysis tool that saved the company upwards of $35,000 in COTS. I continued to make an impact on 2 other major programs at Lockheed Martin before moving on to Qualcomm where I facilitated expedited code fixes for both field testing and customer usage applications. I have experience at Amazon Web Services where I led improvements to recurring release processes and automated testing to eliminate room for error and facilitate more frequent releases. I am currently at Synthego determining the Syligo software roadmap and prioritization of tasking in order to effectively validate new technology, with the goal of deploying this technology across the organization. I value mentoring junior engineers, and have technical leadership experience through my current role by providing task ownership and delegation of tasks to my team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Improve quality of RNA scaffold by 20% by automating RNA synthesis instruments as the sole developer of the Syligo initiative
•Determining Syligo software roadmap and prioritization of tasking in order to effectively validate new technology, with the goal of deploying this technology across the organization
•Modify laboratory instrument dashboard to facilitate streamlined technician operation, reducing time required to complete tasking from 4 hours to just 15 minutes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Led improvements to recurring release process and automated testing to eliminate room for error and facilitate more frequent releases
•Delegated automation tasks to junior engineers and provided ownership of tasks to fruition
•Created concise dashboard to monitor service health across all regions 
•Provided on-call support and issue mitigation for customers
•Performed investigation to determine peak utilization of service hosts in order to right size the fleet of over 15000 hosts

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Developed Apache Airflow DAGs to support new product line that orchestrated all lab functionality, including ordering materials, sending emails and calling internal and external APIs
•Investigated and improved database backup procedure to be more efficient and reduced the process from one hour to 30 minutes
•Improved localized testing workflow for software developers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: •Implemented remote debug feature with Python to facilitate expedited code fixes for both field testing and customer usage applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: •Utilized AngularJS to create a comprehensive and informative dashboard for lab and field testing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Space Programs- (Spring 2019 - Fall 2019) 

•Military Support Programs- Mission Planning (Spring 2018 – Spring 2019 )
- Collaborated with agile team to effectuate modern user interfaces to allow for improved efficiency in satellite mission planning
- Performed quality assurance testing and debugging to ensure the end product met and exceeded requirements
- Engaged in mentoring relationships with new employees and effectively provide useful skillsets and knowledge of the program
- Automated project creation and build process to aid developers in the efficient accomplishment of tasks

•Skyfall Program- Advanced Data Processing (Spring 2017 – Spring 2018)
- Spearheaded the design of a custom SAR processing software suite to analyze imagery that saved the program $35,000 in software costs
- Gained experience utilizing VCS, build tools, and communication frameworks  

•Stretch Assignments
- Orchestrated development of Mission Insight Tracker by utilizing skills in Microsoft Access to integrate a relational database backend with user-friendly front end
- Facilitated transition of existing legacy roadmaps tool to modern web-based system

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•Utilized knowledge of existing legacy system to create a more efficient prototype resulting in a simplified automated data analysis process
•Implemented fully-functional prototype through continuous integration using SVN to version and distribute code

positions.title: Tutor - (Computer Science and Mathematics)
positions.description:
•Helped students understand computer science concepts that weren't as clear while in class
•Provided guidance on computer science projects for all levels
•Gave additional insight on all levels of mathematics

I have always enjoyed learning difficult concepts and making them easier for those around me. My friends and family have said I have the gift of teaching and I love helping anyone and everyone.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
•Developed a dynamic web interface using RESTful API to create an ergonomic, user-friendly dashboard for monitoring business activity
•Created back-end server to integrate business services with four business partners via RESTful web API
•Communicated with CEO to evaluate web application options that would effectively meet business needs
•Educated company-wide personnel on the functionality of the web interface and how to use it for their needs
